project.name: algo-trade-platform
project.description: A trading-strategy simulation and backtesting platform for retail traders, built as eight Spring Cloud microservices. Today it runs self-contained on market data already in its own MySQL schemas; a Tinkoff API market-data feed is the planned next milestone and is not implemented yet.
project.primaryGoal: Let a user enter a trading strategy and see its analysis, simulated trades and profitability against real market data before risking capital.
project.targetAudience: Retail traders and investors, from investment beginners to professionals
plannedIntegrations: Tinkoff API market-data feed (declared intent in README.md; zero references in Java sources or poms as of 2026-11-09)

environments.development: Local: Consul 8500 (discovery), config-service 8888 (native profile), gateway-service 3535, auth-service 9000, admin-service 5555; person-service / user-service / notification-service on random ports (server.port: 0). MySQL: persons_schema :3306, users_schema :3307.
